description: Practice with Academy teaching guides, preserve evidence and connect canonical AI Architect delivery in your own workspace.

interface.longDescription: Practice with public teaching methods, preserve an attempt, critique and test transfer. Prepare a local handoff to the separate AI Architect Academy and its canonical team. The host supplies the conversation; the public MCP accepts catalog IDs only. The local handoff grants no private access, deployment authority or architecture verification.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a Starlight Academy challenge.
Guide my first attempt before showing a solution.
Help me give useful feedback when AI gets something wrong.
